# KMX Media

> Practical local web design, WordPress repair, workflow websites, and AI integration for Minnesota small businesses.

## Services

- Urgent WordPress repairs (SSL/HTTPS, broken pages, plugin conflicts) — typically from $250
- Workflow websites: calls, bookings, quote requests, customer intake, follow-up
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile conversion support
- Booking and reservation systems with business rules (hours, party minimums, capacity)
- Practical AI workflow agents: first response, routing, reminders, handoff summaries
- AI-readable site structure (llms.txt, schema, consistent business facts)
- Website migration to managed hosting ($250 one-time) + hosting and base support ($79–$109/mo, 2–5 support requests/month; standard $89 for 3 requests)
- Email marketing setup and ongoing web care (optional)

## Service area

Northfield, Twin Cities metro, Rochester, southern Minnesota.
